verdict.rationale: Exporting chat history and account data is a fair trust-control question for a consumer AI assistant like ChatGPT, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a data-export feature. The closest items cover adjacent things: data controls applying to Computer Use screenshots, downloading generated files, and Profile activity insights. None of these is an export of chat history or account data.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can export my complete chat history and account data
